site.ogTitle: {project} - Logisiyɛll Tilg-rãabo Tũudum sẽn Ka Be Ne Yiir-ramba
site.ogDescription: Tilg-rãabo tũudum peer-to-peer ne tehnology paalga sẽn ka be ne yiir-ramba. Sɛrver yiir-paal ka be ye. Zĩig sẽn ka be tooro ye.

hero.subtitle: Yʋʋm-paalg tilg-rãabo tũudum peer-to-peer
hero.description: Ne tehnology paalga sẽn ka be ne yiir-ramba. Sɛrver yiir-paal ka be ye. Zĩig sẽn ka be tooro ye.

about.title: B yelle
about.intro: {project} yaa platifɔrm yʋʋm-paalg ne tilg-rãabo tũudum peer-to-peer b sʋga rãmb ne tehnology paalga sẽn ka be ne yiir-ramba. A naagda interfɛs sẽn yaa ne tũudum ne arsitektir sẽn ka be ne yiir-ramba zãnga, n wat ne tilg tũudum sẽn yaa sõma la sẽn yaa ne tagsg ka tar tũudum ne yiir-ramba ye. Tʋʋmd-kãngã yaa open source, b yiisd-a-la ne {license}.

decentralized.title: Reso sẽn ka be ne yiir-ramba zãnga
decentralized.description: Sɛrver yiir-paal ka be ye, zĩig sẽn ka be tooro ye. Tũudbã yãta n rɩkda nyaktã yẽmb ne yẽmb, b ka rat-a tʋʋma ne indɛksɛr, trakɛr, walla baz données yiir-paal ye.

accessControl.title: Tũudum sẽn yaa pekẽgr
accessControl.description: Ned baa kẽ tõe n sɩnga a meng resoo zaalem ne a meng noyã. Reso fãa pʋgẽ, bilg tũudbã tʋʋmde: soaba, admin, pubɛlsɩr, modɛratɛr la rɩka. Tũ pekẽgr soab sẽn tõe n pubɛlsi, n moderẽ, la a rɩka nyak.

ui.title: Interfɛs tũudb sẽn yaa nooma
ui.description: Interfɛs santral média sẽn yaa pelg la pelg, b sʋga b ne tablo, TV la platifɔrm-rãmb mobil. Cengo sẽn yaa pãngã ne klaviɛ, sõuri, manɛt zãma walla télekomãnd. Tũudb sẽn paam-b tõnde tõe n nĩnga logisiyɛll wala sɛrver tilg sẽn ka tar zugu ne ligɣɛ kommãnd interfɛs.

dataFormat.title: Dõneere format ned tõe n karme
dataFormat.description: Dõneere format LISH b sʋga rãmb ne JSON, n kõ noom kõnde, karẽ la wʋmde. Tũudum y nyaakã ne metadonées sẽn yaa pelg la transparã ned baa kẽ tõe n geta ne nooma.

security.title: Vĩs-koɛɛga la kogenda
security.description: Komunikasɩõ peer-to-peer fãa b kibel-rãmb-a, n wilgdẽ tɩ y data wã pa be vĩs-koɛɛga pʋgẽ tʋʋmd pʋgẽ. Tũudb tõe n sõlim VPN poorẽ ne tʋʋmd anonim sẽn yaa paasdg. {project} pasgda y vĩs-koɛɛga ne dizayn.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Logisiyɛll wã yaa Windows, Linux la macOS zugu. Tʋʋma ne aparɛy buud y sẽn rat ye.

download.title: Rɩka
download.description: Paam {project} y platifɔrm yĩnga. Rɩkdsã fãa yaa zaalem la open source.

macos.title: Gomde sẽn yaa pãnga macOS tũudbã yĩnga:
macos.intro: macOS Gatekeeper na n pagda aplikasɩyõ-rãmb sẽn pa sɩjɩne/notarize wã y sẽn rɩg ɛntɛrnɛt zugu, ne tudgr {error}.
macos.error: "a sãama, a pa tõe pakr ye"
macos.runCommand: Y rɩg DMG wall ZIP poorẽ, sã n pa zĩig y na n pak aplikasɩyõ wã, kẽn kommãnd kãngã Terminal pʋgẽ:
macos.explanation: A na n yiisa atribit karãten n basa aplikasɩyõ wã n kẽne.
